regime_context: China A-shares detector shows an extremely narrow, one-narrative regime: only Coal (rank 1) and Banks (rank 3) are trend-eligible out of 22 themes, with Coal as sole leader and rotation breadth at 0.09. Critically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold drawdown on this market's history (gate_helps=false), and cross-sectional momentum rank-IC is ~0 — so the only validated edge is absent here, and the note must lean very low. Track record (dir_accuracy 0.337, hit rate 0.52 on n=98) further argues for humility.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (rank 2, score 0.935) is the challenger but is eligible=false with breadth=0.0 and an unscorable proxy — watching whether it gains eligibility AND positive breadth while the leader-to-challenger margin (currently 0.057) closes below 0.03 would be the condition that elevates it to a confirmed handoff.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only theme that is simultaneously eligible, rank-1, uncrowded (crowding_z 0.59), and the sole confirmed leader in a one-narrative regime. Durability_bar of 0.52 is above the 0.5 display threshold and it is the headline theme. However, its hurst_tag is mean-revert, its breadth is only 0.5, and the market's own trend gate did not hold here, so any lean is a fragile conditional at best.
evidence: one_narrative=true with Coal as sole leader
theses.dissent: Coal is mean-reverting (hurst_tag=mean-revert), breadth is only half the universe, and the absolute-trend gate demonstrably failed to cut drawdown on China A-shares history — so an overweight here is trusting a coincident leadership signal in a tape that whipsaws trend-following discipline.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) closes below the CSI 300 by 5% cumulative over any 10-trading-day stretch within the next 20 days

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only other eligible theme and has the strongest durability_bar in the entire set (0.83) with full breadth (1.0), but it is crowded (crowding_z 1.83, crowded=true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade or sell — so the honest expression of a crowded-but-trending-eligible theme is a relative underweight versus the cleaner Coal position, not a short or avoid. This is a mild relative preference, not a conviction call on direction.
evidence: crowded=true (crowding_z=1.83) — reflexivity caution, do not fade
theses.dissent: Banks has the strongest trend health by durability and breadth, and fading or underweighting the most durable eligible theme in a mean-reverting tape risks missing the one structurally sound leadership — crowding does not imply a reversal, only down-sizing.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) outperforms 515220.SS (Coal ETF) by 5% cumulative over any 10-trading-day stretch within the next 20 days
